categories.name: Account, Access & Authentication
categories.definition: Login, identity, provisioning, permissions and tenancy problems.

categories.name: Billing, Subscription & Invoicing
categories.definition: Charges, invoices, plans, usage metering and renewals for the vendor's own service.

categories.name: Integrations & Connectors
categories.definition: Pre-built and custom connectors to ERP, e-commerce, iPaaS and partner apps.

categories.name: API, SDK & Developer Experience
categories.definition: Direct API/SDK usage, versioning, limits and developer documentation.

categories.name: Data Accuracy, Sync & Reconciliation
categories.definition: Missing, duplicated, mistimed or mismatched records across systems.

categories.name: Configuration & Setup
categories.definition: Onboarding, mappings, rules, hierarchy, entitlements and change management.

categories.name: Compliance, Tax & Regulatory
categories.definition: Tax determination, registrations, exemptions, filings and audits (Avalara-weighted).

categories.name: Payments, Payouts & Risk
categories.definition: Authorisation, disputes, payouts, KYC, fraud and settlement (Stripe-weighted).

categories.name: Performance, Availability & Incidents
categories.definition: Outages, degradation, backlogs, capacity events and security inquiries.

categories.name: Usability, Reporting & Feature Requests
categories.definition: Navigation, reporting, product gaps, UI defects, localisation and enablement.

classes.name: SSO / SAML login failure
classes.description: Customer users cannot authenticate via their IdP; assertion, certificate or attribute mapping is broken.

classes.name: MFA lockout / lost device
classes.description: User cannot complete second factor after device loss, reset or enrolment change.

classes.name: Password reset email not delivered
classes.description: Reset link never arrives; blocked by mail filters, alias mismatch or suppression list.
example_phrases: the password reset email never showed up, checked spam too
I've requested a reset link three times and nothing arrives
reset email isn't coming through, is our domain blocked somehow

classes.name: SCIM / directory provisioning not syncing
classes.description: Users or groups fail to create, update or deprovision from the customer directory.

classes.name: Role / permission misassignment
classes.description: User has too much or too little access; role model does not match the customer's intent.

classes.name: Admin ownership transfer / orphaned account
classes.description: The only admin has left; ownership must be verified and reassigned.

classes.name: Sandbox vs production access
classes.description: Customer cannot reach, or has confused, the non-production environment.

classes.name: Unexpected session timeout / logout
classes.description: Sessions expire early or inconsistently across tabs, devices or embedded contexts.

classes.name: IP allowlist / network restriction block
classes.description: Requests rejected by allowlist, egress IP change, proxy or zero-trust policy.
example_phrases: we just moved offices and now the API is blocking every request from our new IP
getting a network restriction error, nothing changed on our end except our office IP
our requests are being rejected, I think we're not on the allowlist anymore
VPN / proxy change and now we can't reach the API at all

classes.name: Duplicate tenant / account merge
classes.description: Customer created two accounts or acquired an entity and needs consolidation.

classes.name: Unexpected overage charge
classes.description: Invoice exceeds expectation because usage passed a plan threshold.

classes.name: Invoice dispute / incorrect amount
classes.description: Customer contests line items, quantities or the invoice period.
example_phrases: this invoice is charging us for way more seats than we actually have
the amount on this month's invoice doesn't match what we agreed to
why does our bill show a full month when we cancelled halfway through
there's a line item on here I don't recognize at all

classes.name: Failed payment on subscription
classes.description: Card decline, expired instrument or bank block puts the subscription at risk.

classes.name: Plan upgrade / downgrade not reflected
classes.description: Entitlements or limits do not match the plan the customer purchased.

classes.name: Proration confusion
classes.description: Mid-cycle change produced credits or charges the customer does not understand.

classes.name: Refund or credit memo request
classes.description: Customer asks for money back or a credit against a future invoice.

classes.name: Renewal terms & auto-renew cancellation
classes.description: Customer wants to stop, change or renegotiate an upcoming renewal.
example_phrases: we want to cancel before the auto-renewal hits next month
nobody told us this was going to auto-renew, we need this stopped
can we renegotiate the terms before this renews automatically
please turn off auto-renew on our account before the next billing cycle

classes.name: Usage metering discrepancy
classes.description: Metered counts in the invoice disagree with the customer's own telemetry.

classes.name: PO / procurement / net-terms invoicing
classes.description: Purchase order, tax ID, remit-to or payment-terms requirements from procurement.

classes.name: VAT / GST on the vendor's own invoice
classes.description: Customer needs the vendor's invoice re-issued with correct tax treatment or registration number.

classes.name: ERP connector auth token expiry
classes.description: NetSuite / SAP / Dynamics connector stops syncing after a credential or token change.

classes.name: E-commerce connector sync failure
classes.description: Shopify / Magento / BigCommerce orders stop flowing or flow with missing attributes.

classes.name: Marketplace app version incompatibility
classes.description: A partner-published app version conflicts with the current platform release.

classes.name: Webhook delivery failure / retry storm
classes.description: Endpoint returns errors or times out; events are delayed, retried or dropped.

classes.name: Field mapping mismatch
classes.description: Source and destination fields are mapped incorrectly or a required field is unmapped.

classes.name: iPaaS / middleware misconfiguration
classes.description: Boomi, MuleSoft, Workato or Celigo flow is misrouting or transforming records wrongly.

classes.name: Duplicate records from bidirectional sync
classes.description: Two-way sync loops produce duplicates or ping-pong updates.

classes.name: Connector upgrade regression
classes.description: A connector release broke behaviour that previously worked.

classes.name: Unsupported custom integration pattern
classes.description: Homegrown integration uses a pattern the platform does not officially support.

classes.name: Multi-entity / multi-instance routing
classes.description: Records must route to the correct legal entity, region or platform instance.

classes.name: 401 / 403 authentication error
classes.description: API key, OAuth token, scope or signature is invalid or insufficient.
example_phrases: our API calls are all returning 401 now, nothing changed on our side
getting a 403 forbidden on an endpoint that used to work fine
the OAuth token we're using keeps getting rejected as invalid
API key seems to have stopped authenticating overnight

classes.name: Rate limit / 429 throttling
classes.description: Client exceeds request or concurrency limits and needs backoff or a limit increase.

classes.name: Idempotency key misuse / duplicate submission
classes.description: Retries create duplicate objects because idempotency is absent or misapplied.

classes.name: Deprecated API version sunset
classes.description: Customer is on a version being retired and must migrate before a deadline.

classes.name: SDK / client library defect
classes.description: A bug or gap in the official SDK blocks the customer's implementation.

classes.name: Malformed request / schema validation error
classes.description: Payload fails validation on required fields, types, enums or nesting.

classes.name: Timeout & retry semantics
classes.description: Client-side timeouts, long-running calls and unclear retry guidance.

classes.name: Sandbox behaves differently from production
classes.description: Test environment returns different results, data or limits than production.

classes.name: Pagination / bulk export limits
classes.description: Large result sets cannot be retrieved within current limits or cursors misbehave.

classes.name: Documentation gap or incorrect sample
classes.description: Docs are missing, ambiguous or contain a non-working example.

classes.name: Missing transactions in reporting
classes.description: Records exist upstream but never appear in the platform's reports.

classes.name: Duplicate transaction records
classes.description: The same transaction appears more than once, inflating totals.

classes.name: Currency conversion / FX rounding
classes.description: Converted amounts or rounding rules disagree with the customer's ledger.

classes.name: Timezone & posting-date mismatch
classes.description: Records land in the wrong period because of timezone or cutoff handling.

classes.name: Backdated / retroactive adjustment
classes.description: Customer needs a correction applied to a closed or historic period.

classes.name: Bulk import file rejected
classes.description: CSV or batch upload fails on format, encoding, size or validation.

classes.name: Export incomplete or truncated
classes.description: Downloaded extract is missing rows, columns or trailing pages.

classes.name: Reconciliation variance vs GL or bank
classes.description: Platform totals do not tie to the general ledger or bank statement.

classes.name: Deleted or archived record recovery
classes.description: Customer needs data restored after an accidental deletion or archive.

classes.name: Data residency / regional store mismatch
classes.description: Records are stored or processed in an unexpected region for compliance purposes.

classes.name: Onboarding / implementation blocked
classes.description: A new customer's go-live is stalled on a configuration dependency.

classes.name: Product / item classification mapping
classes.description: Catalogue items must be mapped to the correct internal classification codes.

classes.name: Custom rule not firing
classes.description: A customer-authored rule, condition or override does not trigger as expected.

classes.name: Company / entity hierarchy setup
classes.description: Parent-child entity, subsidiary or business-unit structure needs to be modelled.

classes.name: Notification & alert configuration
classes.description: Alerts are noisy, missing, or routed to the wrong recipients.

classes.name: Template / branding customisation
classes.description: Documents, emails or portals need customer branding, layout or wording changes.

classes.name: Approval workflow misconfigured
classes.description: Approval chain routes to the wrong approver or stalls in a state.

classes.name: Migration from legacy or competitor system
classes.description: Historical data and configuration must be brought across from another vendor.

classes.name: Feature flag / entitlement not enabled
classes.description: A purchased or trialled capability is not switched on for the tenant.
example_phrases: our licence keys stopped working after we renewed
INVALID_LICENSE_KEY error on activation
we paid for the add-on but it's still greyed out for us
the feature we upgraded for isn't showing up anywhere in the account

classes.name: Bulk configuration change / change control
classes.description: A large config change needs planning, staging, validation and rollback.

classes.name: Incorrect tax rate applied
classes.description: Calculated rate disagrees with the jurisdiction the customer expects.

classes.name: Nexus threshold & registration
classes.description: Customer needs to know where obligations have been triggered and how to register.

classes.name: Exemption certificate invalid or expired
classes.description: A certificate is missing, expired, or fails validation against a transaction.

classes.name: Return filing rejected by jurisdiction
classes.description: A filed return is rejected for schema, credential, or reconciliation reasons.

classes.name: Late filing, penalty & notice handling
classes.description: A jurisdiction notice, penalty or interest assessment must be worked.

classes.name: Product taxability code dispute
classes.description: Customer disagrees with the taxability determination for a product code.

classes.name: Cross-border VAT / GST / customs duty
classes.description: International transaction requires correct place-of-supply and duty treatment.

classes.name: Marketplace facilitator liability
classes.description: Who remits on a marketplace transaction is unclear or configured wrongly.

classes.name: Audit support & documentation request
classes.description: Customer under audit needs transaction-level evidence and reports.

classes.name: Regulatory change / e-invoicing mandate
classes.description: A rate change or new mandate has not been reflected or adopted in time.

classes.name: Payment authorisation decline
classes.description: A charge is declined by the issuer or network and the reason must be diagnosed.

classes.name: Chargeback / dispute evidence
classes.description: A dispute has been raised and evidence must be assembled and submitted in time.

classes.name: Payout delayed or on hold
classes.description: Funds are not arriving on the expected schedule or are being held.

classes.name: Refund not received by end customer
classes.description: A refund was issued but the cardholder has not seen the funds.

classes.name: 3DS / SCA authentication friction
classes.description: Strong customer authentication is failing or over-triggering and hurting conversion.

classes.name: KYC / onboarding verification stuck
classes.description: Identity or business verification is pending, rejected or looping.

classes.name: Fraud / risk rule false positive
classes.description: Legitimate transactions are being blocked by a risk rule or model.

classes.name: Account capability restricted or under review
classes.description: A capability has been limited pending review, blocking the customer's business.

classes.name: Settlement, fee & reserve discrepancy
classes.description: Net settlement does not match expectations after fees, reserves or adjustments.

classes.name: Local payment method / alternative rails
classes.description: A regional method (SEPA, iDEAL, UPI, Pix, ACH) behaves unexpectedly.

classes.name: Full outage / service unavailable
classes.description: The service, or a critical surface of it, is unavailable to the customer.

classes.name: Partial degradation / elevated latency
classes.description: Responses are slow or intermittently failing without a full outage.

classes.name: Slow report or dashboard load
classes.description: A specific report or view takes unacceptably long to render.

classes.name: Batch job / queue backlog
classes.description: Asynchronous processing is backed up and results are late.

classes.name: Scheduled maintenance impact
classes.description: A planned window affected the customer more than expected or was badly timed.

classes.name: Regional or zone-specific failure
classes.description: Only one region, zone or POP is affected.

classes.name: Third-party dependency outage
classes.description: An upstream provider (bank, jurisdiction portal, cloud, carrier) is down.

classes.name: Peak-season capacity event
classes.description: Quarter-end, filing deadline or Black Friday load exceeds normal patterns.

classes.name: Data pipeline lag / stale data
classes.description: Reports show data that is hours or days behind reality.

classes.name: Security inquiry / vulnerability disclosure
classes.description: Customer security team asks about a CVE, pen-test finding or control.

classes.name: Cannot find a feature / navigation confusion
classes.description: The capability exists but the user cannot locate or reach it.

classes.name: Report or metric definition question
classes.description: Customer wants to know exactly how a displayed number is calculated.

classes.name: Custom report build request
classes.description: Customer needs a view or extract that does not exist out of the box.

classes.name: Feature request / product gap
classes.description: The product genuinely does not do what the customer needs.

classes.name: UI defect / rendering issue
classes.description: A visual or interaction bug in a specific browser, resolution or state.

classes.name: Accessibility issue
classes.description: A user with assistive technology cannot complete a task; VPAT questions.

classes.name: Localisation / language / formatting
classes.description: Translations, date, number or address formats are wrong for a locale.

classes.name: Training & enablement request
classes.description: Customer asks for a walkthrough, session or learning path.

classes.name: Mobile app-specific issue
classes.description: Behaviour differs or fails only on the mobile application.

classes.name: UI change / deprecation adoption friction
classes.description: A redesign or removal has disrupted an established customer workflow.
